answer.evidence: Step Rx loss ~2.8dB on 23 Oct after patching at site B ODF, with Tx stable. Power budget: A-TX 0.75 to B-ODF -7.29 = 8.04dB vs 5.41dB commissioning (+2.6dB); B-ODF to B-RX = 7.18dB, matching 7dB design attenuator, so TX and attenuator excluded. Bidirectional embedded OTDR shows single anomalous reflective ~2.9dB loss at B-ODF both ways, while SC-01 1.01/-0.89dB pair averages ~0.06dB (G.652/G.655 MFD mismatch) and MID-PP is normal. Inspection: B-ODF shows loose dark particles/smudge, no crack/scratch (not damaged); A-ODF and MID-PP clean. Clean B-ODF.
